bio: I’m a freelance video editor and colorist passionate about turning raw footage into powerful visual stories. I work with creators, musicians, and brands to create videos that feel cinematic, engaging, and meaningful.

For me, editing is more than just cutting clips together. It’s about finding the right rhythm, creating the right mood, and making every moment count. From eye-catching short-form content to cinematic storytelling and documentaries, I focus on keeping viewers engaged and bringing each project’s vision to life.
With a strong focus on creative editing, color grading, and sound design, I put care and precision into every frame to deliver visuals that stand out and leave a lasting impression.
about.careerGoals: Advancing boundary-pushing cinematic narratives in commercial advertising and short cinema, while helping ambitious brands dominate high-converting short-form formats.
about.availabilityStatus: Available for Select Projects & Monthly Retainers

creativeProcess.title: Ingest & Creative Alignment
creativeProcess.subtitle: Briefing, Footage Review & Script Breakout
creativeProcess.description: Organize raw footage, establish proxy workflows, sync multi-camera audio, and align on rhythm, target duration, and emotional arc.

creativeProcess.title: The Narrative Assembly (Rough Cut)
creativeProcess.subtitle: Story Structure & Core Pacing
creativeProcess.description: Shape the narrative foundation. Identify golden moments, cull filler, and lock the timing before introducing heavy styling.

creativeProcess.title: Sound Design & Atmosphere
creativeProcess.subtitle: Foley, Risers, Bass Drops & Dialogue Cleanup
creativeProcess.description: Audio is 50% of the cinematic experience. Layer bespoke sound effects, adjust volume automations, and clean dialogue.

creativeProcess.title: Color Grading & Motion Graphics
creativeProcess.subtitle: Look Development, ACES & Typography
creativeProcess.description: Grade footage to establish mood and tonal continuity across shots. Integrate custom motion graphics, lower-thirds, and visual flares.

creativeProcess.title: Master Delivery & Format Optimization
creativeProcess.subtitle: Multi-Aspect Ratio Export & Quality Control
creativeProcess.description: Deliver pristine master exports optimized for web (YouTube, Instagram 9:16, ProRes archive) along with organized project archives.

services.title: Short-Form Video Editing
services.shortDescription: High-octane vertical edits (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) crafted with snappy visual hooks, kinetic text, and retention-maximizing audio.
services.fullDescription: Designed for high-growth brands and creators looking to scale organic reach. I dissect your long-form video or raw phone recordings to pinpoint viral concepts, add subtitles, dynamic zooms, memes/b-roll, and custom sound design.
services.idealFor: Content Creators, Personal Brands, E-commerce Founders

services.title: YouTube Editing
services.shortDescription: Strategic pacing, intro retention hooks, B-roll overlays, and narrative editing that drives watch time and algorithmic performance.
services.fullDescription: Turn your raw A-roll and multi-cam recordings into polished episodes. Includes audio leveling, custom graphics, smooth chaptering, soundscape balancing, and retention graphs optimization.
services.idealFor: Full-time YouTubers, Tech Reviewers, Video Essayists

services.title: Social Media Content Packages
services.shortDescription: Multi-platform content repurposing turning long-form podcasts, webinars, or keynotes into 15-30 modular social clips.
services.fullDescription: Maximize your production ROI. Send one long recording, receive a calendar of multi-aspect assets ready to schedule across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
services.idealFor: Podcasters, CEOs, Thought Leaders, SaaS Marketing Teams

services.title: Cinematic Storytelling
services.shortDescription: Artful pacing, emotional arc construction, seamless transitions, and documentary-grade immersion.
services.fullDescription: For narrative short films, brand origin documentaries, and high-production case studies. Focuses on character pacing, emotional beats, voice-over interplay, and dramatic tension.
services.idealFor: Film Directors, Boutique Agencies, Luxury Brands

services.title: Color Correction & Grading
services.shortDescription: Precision shot balancing, color gamut matching, ACES color management, and cinematic look development in DaVinci Resolve.
services.fullDescription: Transform flat, dull LOG footage into striking filmic imagery. Fix exposure discrepancies between different cameras, skin tone isolation, sky enhancements, and customized film grain/halation profiles.
deliverables: Show LUT (.cube) for client future use
services.idealFor: Commercial DPs, Indie Filmmakers, Music Video Directors

services.title: Sound Design & Audio Finishing
services.shortDescription: Multi-layered foley, spatial sound effects, dialogue denoising, impactful risers, and broadcast loudness compliance.
services.fullDescription: Sound is what makes visual edits feel tactile and real. I build custom atmospheres, crisp mechanical foley, bass impacts, and clean dialogue with spectral repair.
deliverables: Stereo Master Mix (-14 LUFS web standard)

services.title: Motion Graphics & Text Animation
services.shortDescription: Custom lower thirds, kinetic typography, 2D infographic callouts, logo reveals, and UI screen simulations.
services.fullDescription: Give your video a slick, television-grade polish with custom After Effects animations that clarify complex ideas and reinforce brand identity.
services.idealFor: SaaS Explainers, Corporate Presentations, Tech Creators

services.title: Promotional Video Editing
services.shortDescription: High-conversion product promos, event teasers, Kickstarter campaign videos, and paid ad creatives.
services.fullDescription: Built with direct-response principles to capture attention within the first 3 seconds and drive viewers towards a clear call to action.
deliverables: 3 Alternative Hook Variations for A/B Testing
services.idealFor: Startups, E-commerce, Event Producers, Product Launches
